prompts.item-icons-v2: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one production RPG inventory texture atlas, exactly FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, square image. Transparent background, no borders, no text, no labels, no shadows outside objects. Exactly 16 separate evenly spaced painted anime fantasy item icons, one centered icon per equal square cell, generous 12% inset inside every cell; all icons same visual scale and crisp legibility when small. Exact reading order row 1: single simple straight iron practice sword with brown grip; folded plain brown linen trousers; teal short sleeved traveller tunic; pair of brown leather tall boots. Row 2: simple open iron helmet with unobstructed face; brown leather vest; short sleeveless silver chainmail shirt; silver iron breastplate with two shoulder plates. Row 3: tied bundle of green meadow herbs with small cream flowers; three cut brown timber logs; grey iron ore chunk with dark metallic veins; rusty copper ore chunk with warm copper veins. Row 4: small tied beige sack of flour with no writing; folded small rabbit fur pelt; copper necklace with pendant; simple copper ring. Style polished hand-painted anime MMO item art, controlled cel shaded shadow shapes, warm highlights, no photorealism, no ornamental UI. All 16 distinct icons fully inside their allotted cells, nothing touching neighbouring cells.
